CapabilityPath.description: A capability path such as `permission.prompt` or `remote.purposes`.

NotificationAdvertisingRules.description: `kr` applies the Korean advertising rules to every recipient; `none` keeps consent and the opt-out route only.

name.description: The sender's name; leave it out only when it equals the app's name.

contact.description: The phone number or address the law requires.

NotificationAdvertisingSender.description: The deployment's advertising sender, which every advertising send carries under `kr`.

open.description: How an open reaches the game.

NotificationCapabilities.description:
Notifications v2 capability declaration. A provider returns a fresh object
on every read; code branches on these declarations, never on a provider id
or target name. Release gates such as Devvit's `approval-required` stay in
the target config's `integrations.notifications` state.

NotificationChannel.description: `remote` is a server-sent push, `local` a device-scheduled notification.

timeZone.description: The device's zone, which the runtime registers.

link.description: A post or comment id for providers whose sends need a link.

prompts.description: Calls that reached the host prompt API.

deliveries.description: Every outcome answered or stored for a send key, in order.

providerCalls.description: Every provider attempt, including one answered `rate-limited`.

notices.description: The backend's listed notices at the end, ordered by `dueBy` and then `kind`.

actionRequired.description:
Starts the fixture provider in `availability: 'action-required'` with
`requiredAction: 'login'` (a logged-out Devvit player) until `completeAction`.

NotificationConformanceInstallationFixtu.description: Another installation of the same player, registered directly with the backend.

variant.description: The variant of `notices.copy` the notice is listed with.

NotificationConformancePredicate.description: A predicate on the provider's capabilities; every predicate must hold for the vector to run.

limits.description: Server-side limits of the provider's registry entry.

perUserPerDay.description: Deliveries to one player within any 24 hours.

perUserPerMinute.description: Deliveries to one player within any 60 seconds.

NotificationConformanceProfileLimits.description: Per-recipient limits of the provider's registry entry.

address.description: The device address value the attempt went to.

link.description: The send's link; `null` asserts that the call carried none.

expiresAt.description: The expiry the call carried; `null` asserts that it carried none.

NotificationConformanceRejectionReason.description: Why a provider rejected a send: the project's setup, the recipient, or a missing agreement.

input.description: A listed notice, or its kind, the kind and time of the record it reports on, and its `dueBy`.

retryAfterSeconds.description: With `rate-limited`: the provider's retry delay (60 seconds when absent).

reason.description: With `rejected`: why the provider rejected the send.

appliesTo.description: The capability fields the scenario depends on; a provider runs the vector only when all hold.

catalog.description:
Topic entries with this profile's mapping under `mapping`. Only the topics
the scenario needs; the catalog validator does not check them.

notices.description:
The catalog's `notices` block: the topic the scheduler's notice pushes go
out through, which `catalog` declares with no copy of its own, and their
copy per variant, which follows the catalog's rules.

deployment.description: Backend deployment settings; Asia/Seoul is the zone when `timeZone` is absent.

NotificationConsentSource.description: `provider`: a delivery provider's answer that the recipient has not agreed.

advertisingRules.description:
Required when the catalog has an `advertising` topic: the gate refuses to
evaluate an advertising send without it.

advertisingOptOutLine.description: The free-of-charge opt-out line; `무료 수신거부: 수신거부 버튼` when absent or blank.

timeZone.description: IANA zone for recipients that registered none; Asia/Seoul when absent.

shellRendersAdvertising.description:
Whether the game's shell renders advertising pushes itself, with the
opt-out action, on the targets in
`notificationShellRenderedAdvertisingTargets` (Android, through the
kit's messaging service in `@mpgd/capacitor-game-services`). An Android
FCM notification message cannot carry actions, so the catalog validator
refuses an advertising topic mapped to such a target unless this is
true. With it, the backend still sends advertising under `kr` only to an
installation whose registration says it renders it
(`rendersAdvertising`); one that does not is `suppressed:
purpose-unsupported`. Absent means false.

maxPending.description: Pending-notification ceiling the provider must stay under (iOS: 64).

NotificationLocalCapabilities.description: Local reminders are always inexact, so the capability carries no timing.

record.description: The advertising or night record the notice reports on, with its date.

dueBy.description: The last Asia/Seoul calendar date the notice may be given, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

variant.description:
The variant of `notices.copy` the notice is given in, set when it is
listed, so the game shows the text the scheduler would send.

at.description: RFC 3339 with an explicit offset; compared as an instant.

dueBy.description: The notice's last Asia/Seoul calendar date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

NotificationNoticeIdentity.description:
What names one notice: its kind, the record it reports on (that record's
kind and time), and its `dueBy`. A listed notice carries these fields, and
`notices.recordShown` takes the listed notice as is or exactly them.

NotificationNoticeLocaleCopy.description:
One locale of `notices.copy`: a title and a body for each notice variant.
A refusal's text is optional; without it a refusal is given in the
withdrawal's text (`notificationNoticeVariantFallbacks`).

topic.description: A remote `service` topic that keeps only the delivery settings.

NotificationNoticeSettings.description:
The catalog's `notices` block, which a backend and a vector take as one:
the topic consent notices go out through, and their copy per variant.

NotificationNoticeVariant.description:
The copy a notice is given in: its kind, its record's kind, and for a
result notice what the record was, so the text can say what the player did
(decree art. 62-2): a consent (`granted`), the withdrawal of a consent
(`withdrawn`), or a refusal (`refused`), a `withdrawn` record whose latest
earlier record of its kind is not a consent. A re-confirmation always
reports on a consent (decree art. 62-3). A named union keeps the JSON
Schema names readable.

scope.description: Where delivery permission lives: one for the app, or one per topic.

readable.description: Whether the client can read the current state without prompting.

serverReadable.description: Whether the backend can read the current state at send time (Devvit `isOptedIn`).

allowance.description: 'per-send': one acceptance allows one delivery (WeChat one-time subscriptions).

promptLimit.description:
How many denials the host accepts before only settings can change the
answer: iOS 1, Android 13+ 2. A dismissed dialog is not a denial. Absent
when the host can always ask again (Apps in Toss, Devvit, WeChat).

settings.description: Whether `openSettings` can open the OS or host notification settings.

NotificationPermissionOutcome.description:
What one `requestPermission` call produced for a topic: the host's answer
when the prompt ran ('granted', 'already-granted', 'denied', and
'dismissed' when it closed without an answer), 'blocked' when the host
refused for good or the call did not reach the prompt because the host read
was already blocked, 'action-required' when the host needs a player action
before it can prompt (`requiredAction` names it), and 'unavailable' when the
provider is unsupported or the topic has no mapping for it. The snapshot
carries the resulting state, so a second Android denial reports outcome
'denied' with snapshot 'blocked'.

NotificationPurpose.description: What a topic is for; it decides the consent a send needs (RFC "Topics and purposes").

NotificationQuietHours.description: Holds sends from `start` (inclusive) to `end` (exclusive); `start` after `end` spans midnight.

NotificationReminderStatus.description:
A reminder's answer (RFC `ReminderResult`). The local route reports the
gate's `permission-denied` as `permission-required`.

purposes.description: Purposes the host lets the server deliver.

NotificationRequiredAction.description: The player action a host needs before it can prompt.

route.description: The route the open leads to; it must pass `isRootRelativeNotificationRoute`.

optOutRoute.description: Required for `advertising`: the screen where the player withdraws advertising consent.

deferrable.description:
`false`: a send held by the night window or the topic's quiet hours is
suppressed instead of deferred. Default `true`.

NotificationTopicDeclaration.description: A topic resolved for one provider: the definition plus that target's mapping.

maxPerDay.description: Deliveries of the topic to one player within any 24 hours.

PlatformProviderAvailability.description: Readiness of an installed platform provider, independent of target policy.

RecordNotificationNoticeInput.description:
The notice `notices.recordShown` records: a notice as `notices.list()` gave
it, or exactly its name (its kind, the kind and time of the record it
reports on, and its `dueBy`).
